title: Butter Chicken
subtitle: Classic Indian chicken in a rich tomato and butter sauce
excerpt: Butter chicken -- murgh makhani -- is one of the most popular Indian dishes in the world. Marinated chicken is charred or roasted first, then simmered in a rich tomato sauce finished with butter and cream. The combination of smoky chicken and velvety sauce is hard to beat.
sourceNotes: Butter chicken was created in the 1950s at Moti Mahal restaurant in Delhi by Kundan Lal Gujral and Kundan Lal Jaggi. Left-over tandoor chicken was simmered in a tomato, butter, and cream sauce. It became one of the defining dishes of Indian restaurant cooking worldwide.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze after the sauce is made but before adding the cream. Add cream when reheating.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Marinate the chicken overnight. The tomato sauce can be made 2 days ahead.

content.text: The colour of the finished sauce depends on cooking the tomatoes fully. The sauce should be deep red-orange and the oil should separate at the edges before you blend it. Do not rush this stage.

items.prepNote: boneless and skinless, cut into large pieces
use Kashmiri chilli powder if available

content.text: Mix the chicken with the yoghurt, garlic-ginger paste, garam masala, paprika, turmeric, and 1 teaspoon of salt. Marinate for at least 1 hour.
Spread the chicken on a roasting tin. Roast at 220 degrees for 20 minutes until charred at the edges and cooked through. Set aside.
Melt half the butter in a large pan. Cook the onion over medium heat for 8 minutes until soft. Add the tinned tomatoes and 0.5 teaspoon of salt.
Cook the tomato sauce over medium heat for 15 minutes, stirring often, until it is very thick and dark. The oil should separate at the edges.
Blend the sauce until smooth. Push through a sieve if you want a very silky result. Return to the pan.
Add the remaining butter and the cream. Stir until the butter melts. Add the roasted chicken. Simmer for 5 minutes. Taste and adjust salt. Serve with naan or basmati rice.

items.fix: Cook the tomato base for longer -- it should be very thick and the colour should deepen to a dark red-orange
Check at 18 minutes -- thighs should read 75 degrees at the centre; they will cook a little more in the sauce

items.cause: The tinned tomatoes were a very sweet variety
items.fix: Add a small squeeze of lemon juice to cut through the sweetness

content.text: Butter chicken was invented in Delhi but belongs to the world now. It is the most ordered Indian dish in UK restaurants and one of the most recognised Indian dishes in North America and Australia. The Delhi original used leftover tandoor chicken and a simple tomato-butter sauce -- this recipe follows that logic, roasting the chicken first to get the right charred flavour.
